Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied original pixel crop.
Extract ONLY the complete clawed foot including its patterned lower shank. Remove the small fragment of the upper limb above/behind the mounting hole. Complete ONLY the truncated upper contour around this hole as a small round paper mounting tab; do not lengthen the shank. Preserve every toe, black claw, length/width ratio, angle and crescent marking. Do not merge or replace toes.
Keep the original paper cutout appearance, color, fiber texture, orientation and silhouette. No redesign or mirroring. ONE complete part, centered with transparent margin and genuinely transparent alpha background and mounting hole. No neighboring fragments, text, new joint rings, shadow, red/yellow fringe or opaque matte.
